description: List the Meta product catalogs connected to this channel's WhatsApp Business Account. Only id and name are returned unless `fields` asks for more. Use the catalog id with mba_list_catalog_products. This list is CURSOR-PAGINATED: it returns {data, paging} - page with the `after` cursor from paging.cursors, and stop when paging carries no `next` link, because a page can be empty and still have more after it.

after.description: Cursor - return the page immediately after it.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

before.description: Cursor - return the page immediately before it.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,name,product_count,vertical. Default: id,name.

limit.description: Maximum entries per page. A page can be shorter.

name: mba_list_product_catalogs

outputSchema.description: Product catalogs connected to the WhatsApp Business Account

data.description: Catalogs connected to the WhatsApp Business Account

items.description: A product catalog. Only id and name are returned by default; request other fields with the fields query parameter

checkout_urls.description: Checkout URLs, one per sell-to country; omitted when none is configured

items.description: Checkout URL for one sell-to country

da_display_settings.description: Image display settings (background cropping, padding) for items in each Dynamic Ad format

default_image_url.description: Image used for products without an image, or while a product image is unavailable

fallback_image_url.description: Fallback images used for auto-generated dynamic items

feed_count.description: Total number of feeds used by the catalog

is_catalog_segment.description: Whether this is a catalog segment rather than a full catalog

is_local_catalog.description: Whether this is a local catalog

name.description: Name of the catalog, given by its creator

product_count.description: Total number of products in the catalog

vertical.description: Type of catalog. Known values: adoptable_pets, apps_and_software, articles_and_publications, commerce, destinations, flights, generic, home_listings, hotels, local_service_businesses, media_titles, offer_items, services, offline_commerce, transactable_items, vehicles.

paging.description: Cursor pagination. next/previous point back at this API; follow them directly, or page manually with the after/before query parameters

next.description: URL of the next page as issued by Meta

previous.description: URL of the previous page as issued by Meta

title: List product catalogs
